What Is an Online B Com Degree?

An online B Com degree is a 3-year undergraduate program in commerce that blends financial, business, and economic education with the flexibility of virtual learning. Unlike traditional degrees that require physical attendance, this program allows you to study at your own pace—from anywhere.

At Dayananda Sagar University, the online B Com course goes beyond foundational commerce by integrating emerging fields like Digital Business Strategy, preparing you for modern corporate roles and digital entrepreneurship.
Why Choose Digital Business Strategy?
Digital Business Strategy focuses on how organizations use digital tools and technologies to improve operations, innovate services, and compete globally.
With businesses going paperless, data-driven, and cloud-based, professionals who understand the interplay between business models and technology are in high demand.

FAQs
01. Is the online B Com degree valid in India?
Yes. A UGC-approved online BCom degree is fully valid for government jobs, corporate roles, and higher studies.
02. What is the fee for an online BCom degree?
The online BCom degree fees range from ₹30,000 to ₹90,000 per year, depending on the university and features included.
03. Can I do MBA or MCom after this program?
Absolutely. This degree is equivalent to any traditional BCom and qualifies you for postgraduate courses like MBA, MCom, and other PG diplomas.
04. What is the course duration?
The course is spread across 3 years, with flexible timelines for project submissions and exams.
05. What are the benefits of a digital business specialization?
You learn how businesses operate in a tech-driven world—making you ready for high-demand roles in digital marketing, strategy, and innovation.
